Only one condition fails: gain at sf/-40C/1.62V is 68.6 dB against a 71 dB target, about 2.4 dB short. The topology is fine, so this is a refine.

The first-stage gain is limited by the PMOS load M3/M4 (gm/gds ≈ 122). Longer channels on the PMOS loads (L4) and the NMOS sinks (Lb) should recover the missing gain. Phase margin (63°) is tight, so Cc and the zero resistor stay free to keep it up.
